planted.item: The committee decided to keep the break option open and not to waive it in any negotiation.
The committee agreed to reject the landlord's demand and ask them to repair the roof.
The attorney will diarise the last date for serving notice and confirm it to the committee in writing next week.
The client will collect the photographs and repair invoices by the fifteenth.
The attorney will write to the landlord about the roof once the client sends them the photographs.
It is unclear whether the insurer will cover the stock damaged by the leak.
